chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام:
About salat (prayer) in the bathhouse, so he said: “If the place is clean, then there is no harm in salat (prayer),” meaning the changing area.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer) being asked about in this ruling
key_terms.الْمَسْلَخَ: the changing area of the bathhouse
key_terms.الْمَوْضِعُ: the specific place where one would pray
key_terms.بَيْتِ الْحَمَّامِ: the bathhouse as the location under discussion
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray in a bathhouse if the place is clean?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing salat (prayer) in a bathhouse. Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that if the place is clean, there is no harm in praying there, specifically referring to the changing area.
